**Octahedral coordinates from the Wirtinger presentation Calvin McPhail-Snyder Duke University calvin@sl2.site**

21 pp, 6 sections.

**Abstract.** Letρ be a representation of a knot group (or more generally, the funda- mental group of a tangle complement) intoSL2(C) expressed in terms of the Wirtinger generators of a diagramD. This diagram also determines an ideal triangulation of the complement called the octahedral decompo- sition.ρ induces a hyperbolic structure on the complement ofD, and in this note we give a direct algebraic formula for the geometric parameters of the octahedral decomposition induced by this structure. Our formula gives a new, explicit criterion for whetherρ occurs as a critical point of the diagram’s Neumann-Zagier–Yokota potential function.

**Outline.** Introduction; Octahedral colorings; The holonomy of an octahedral coloring; Gauge transformations; Shape parameters and the potential function; Bibliography
